title: Prisma Project
description: A project represents an application or service within a Prisma workspace. Projects contain environments with database connections and API keys, and serve as the primary organizational unit for Prisma Data Platform resources.

environments.description: Deployment environments configured for the project

databases.description: Prisma Postgres databases associated with the project

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the project was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the project was last updated

Environment.description: A deployment environment within a project representing a stage such as development, staging, or production

connectionString.description: Database connection string for this environment

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the environment was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the environment was last updated

DatabaseReference.description: A reference to a Prisma Postgres database associated with the project

region.description: Region where the database is deployed
